target.validation_method: root SSH, fresh RBF load, headless ARM engine session with dummy SDL video/audio, and read-only shared-DDR state dump; no Computer Use or HDMI visual inspection

interpretation: The real ARM DevilutionX binary found the board DIABDAT asset, published indexed frames into shared DDR, and the freshly loaded FPGA retired frames and acknowledged presentation metadata without a transport fault. The nonzero display epoch and last-presented ID prove the display acknowledgement path is live on the board.
scope_limit: The run used dummy video/audio and no physical input. HDMI image quality, tear-free visual inspection, physical audio, controller/keyboard traffic, combined reset stress, deterministic gameplay and 60 FPS pacing remain open.
